title: Stars & Stripes
shortDescription: American flag wood art, hand-cut and finished with a rustic, weathered touch.
description: Each flag starts as raw, rough-cut lumber before it's layered, stained, and distressed by hand into a piece that feels like it's been in the family for generations. No two boards weather quite the same way, so no two flags ever come out alike.

title: From the Heart
shortDescription: Wooden heart décor and love-themed pieces for the ones who matter most.
description: Warm, simple, and made to be given. This collection covers hand-cut wooden hearts, layered love-note signs, and small accent pieces meant for a mantel, a nursery shelf, or a gift that says more than a card ever could.

images.alt: Layered wooden heart wall décor in stained finish
Small hand-cut wood hearts arranged on a shelf
Rustic wooden heart sign with hand-lettered accent
Wood heart ornament with burned edge detail

title: Crafted Keepsakes
shortDescription: Custom engraved gifts, made to hold a name, a date, or a memory.
description: Personalized, engraved keepsakes built for milestones — a family name sign, a wedding date plaque, a memorial piece. Every order in this collection is one-of-one, engraved and finished by hand to fit exactly what the moment calls for.
